_doc: F02 VESPER stage 1: one still per shot (prompt lock + colour world + negatives).

args.prompt: Golden-hour lifestyle close-up on a city rooftop balcony: an elegant woman's hand with a thin gold ring holds the exact perfume bottle from the reference image (heavy rectangular thick clear-glass bottle, amber-gold perfume, tall faceted smoky-amber cap with a thin gold collar, VESPER engraved in wide-spaced serif capitals on the front) at chest height against her deep-burgundy tailored satin blazer, bottle front facing camera with VESPER legible; her face is out of frame. Behind, soft out-of-focus city skyline and a low warm sun flare. Natural skin texture, relaxed graceful hand. Portra 400 film look, 85mm, f/2.8. Colour world deep burgundy, black and warm amber-gold. No other text.
